commercialObjective: Show how to evaluate the operating path behind a fast AI service launch.
whyThisWon: The current ServiceNow customer story names a deployment window and a concrete portal-replacement event without overlapping an active client, prospect, employer, or application.
postText:
ServiceNow's September 23 customer story says INRY deploys ServiceNow EmployeeWorks in six weeks, replacing its legacy portal with an AI front door to work.

The public page leaves the underlying control path open. My teardown hypothesis would inspect one employee request from intake through outcome.

I would trace the employee request and its source context, the system that owns the answer, the point where a human reviews consequential actions, and the final outcome recorded against the original request.

A six-week launch earns attention. A visible request-to-outcome trail earns operational trust.
